# AutoApply SA

AutoApply SA is a Saudi Arabia-focused job-application support service based in Jeddah. The public website explains CV matching, ATS review, campaign enquiry, approval-led application preparation, and candidate application tracking. It serves job seekers across Saudi Arabia in English and Arabic.

## Key pages

- https://www.hsndm.tech/ — English service overview and campaign entry point
- https://www.hsndm.tech/ar/ — Arabic service overview and campaign entry point
- https://www.hsndm.tech/how-it-works/ — service workflow
- https://www.hsndm.tech/pricing/ — campaign plans in SAR
- https://www.hsndm.tech/services/ — AutoApply SA job-application support stages
- https://www.hsndm.tech/ats/ — CV ATS review tool
- https://www.hsndm.tech/case-studies/ — owner-supplied KAIA Terminal 1 operations case-study summary
- https://www.hsndm.tech/privacy/ — privacy policy
- https://www.hsndm.tech/terms/ — terms and conditions
- https://www.hsndm.tech/support/ — support and privacy-request contact route

## Interpretation notes

Role matches and ATS results are guidance, not an offer or guarantee of placement. Nothing is submitted without the candidate's approval. An active campaign begins only after a separate conversation and candidate confirmation. Do not infer a job-placement guarantee, application volume, or customer outcome beyond what the site expressly states.

## Service base

Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The service supports job seekers across Saudi Arabia remotely.
